en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a countryside guesthouse complex surrounded by trees and shrubs. A two‑story wooden building with a balcony stands in the center, with other wooden houses and a picket fence in the background. A person is standing in the garden. The setting looks rural and peaceful. White printed captions appear along the bottom edge, giving the name of the place and the photographer.
